blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Both Manases Carpio and former Senator Antonio Trillanes IV may be invited by the House of Representatives once it starts the legislative inquiry on controversial food processing company CALE88 Foods Corporation. House Deputy Speaker Jefferson Khonghun made the statetement in an online interview on Friday. Khonghun said there is no decision yet on which committees will handle the investigation on CALE88 and its financial transactions and who will be the resource persons. But he believes Carpio and Trillanes will be important to the discussions. Carpio, husband of Vice President Sara Duterte, owns CALE88 — the company mentioned several times during […]...
